About us

A South African company built around practical, reliable work.

Izinkanyezi was established to give individuals, households, entrepreneurs, small businesses and organisations practical, reliable and professional support. Our work rests on clear communication, organised systems, ethical service and careful attention to detail.

Every job starts with a written brief and closes with a follow-up, so clients know what they are buying and can confirm that they received it.

Integrity. Professionalism. Accuracy.

Izinkanyezi is the isiZulu word for stars, which is why a sparkle sits in our logo.

Our vision

To be a trusted business support and advisory partner known for operational discipline, financial integrity, effective communication and meaningful service delivery.

Our mission

To help individuals, households, entrepreneurs, small businesses and organisations operate more efficiently, communicate more clearly, remain compliant and build systems that support sustainable growth and long-term impact.

ReliabilityWe do what we have agreed to do, when we agreed to do it.
IntegrityWe keep honest, complete records and report on them plainly.
PracticalityWe choose solutions that fit the job and the client's budget.
AccountabilityWe stand behind our work and follow up after delivery.
How we work

From first message to finished job.

1

Brief

You tell us what is needed, where and by when.

2

Quote

We reply with a written quotation that sets out scope and price.

3

Deliver

We carry out the work or supply the goods to the agreed brief.

4

Follow up

We confirm that you are satisfied and keep the records you may need later.

What we do

Three services, one reliable team.

One team, one written quotation and one invoice. Every service runs to a clear brief, which leaves your own people free to concentrate on their work.

Operations and logistics

We support the movement of goods, people and schedules so that deliveries and programmes stay on track. Wesley leads this side of the company, drawing on more than twenty years in depots, inventory, supply chain and warehousing, and we coordinate the practical detail so your team is not left chasing it.

We plan deliveries and handovers, keep stock and supplies moving, and support project administration so that each step happens when it should.

Meet the directors

The people behind the name.

Samantha Rabie

Managing director

Samantha is a management consultant and a doctoral candidate in Business Management at the University of Pretoria, and her research examines corporate social responsibility and socio-economic development in organisations listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange. That research background shapes how the company plans each job, keeps its records and reports back to clients.

Fatima Reis

Financial director

Fatima is a director and the financial director of the company. She looks after the financial side of the business, which keeps quotations, invoices and records accurate and easy to follow.

Wesley Rabie

Operations director

Wesley has more than twenty years of experience in manufacturing, logistics and technical operations. His senior roles covered depots, inventory, supply chain and warehousing, including leadership of a team of 89 in multinational manufacturing and distribution, and he now guides the operations and logistics side of Izinkanyezi.

Partner with us

Partnerships let us take on larger and more varied jobs.

Organisations can appoint us directly, and businesses with complementary services can work alongside us on jobs that neither side would carry as well alone. Every partner receives a written brief, a written quotation and honest reporting on progress.

Send an enquiry

Organisations that buy services

Corporates, institutions and public bodies can appoint us for cleaning, events and logistics support.

Suppliers and subcontractors

Businesses that supply cleaning products, event services or transport can tell us what they offer, and we will consider them for jobs where their strengths fit the brief.

Joint bids and consortia

We are open to joining a consortium or submitting a joint bid where a partner's capability and ours complement each other.

      Quick answers
      
Questions suppliers often ask.

    

    

      
What is your B-BBEE status?
Level 2, with 125% procurement recognition. The affidavit is valid until 31 March 2027 and we can send a copy on request.

      
Which documents can you supply?
We can supply our company registration documents (CIPC number 2026/201773/07) and our B-BBEE affidavit. If your supplier onboarding asks for anything else, tell us and we will confirm what we are able to send.

      
How do I get a quote?
Use the form below or email us with the service, the place and the date. We reply with a quotation that sets out the scope and the price.

      
What does it cost?
We do not publish a fixed price list, because the price depends on the scope. Send us a short brief and we reply with a written quotation that shows what is included and the price.

      
Where do you work and how fast can you start?
We are based in Pretoria, Gauteng. Tell us the place and the date when you ask for a quote, and the quotation confirms the location and the earliest start.

      
    
Still have a question?
Message the person who looks after your service and we will answer on WhatsApp.
